name: About Alive & Who Our Programs Are For

items.q: What is the Alive philosophy?
a: The Alive PhilosophyAlive was not created as a wellness business. It was created from lived experience.When the founder of Alive faced severe burnout and health challenges in her early twenties, she searched the world for somewhere that could truly support her. There were luxury spas, yoga retreats and medical clinics, but nowhere that addressed the whole person. Health, mindset, emotional wellbeing, purpose and lifestyle were treated separately rather than as one integrated experience.Alive was created to fill that gap.Since 2009, Alive has been built on the belief that true wellbeing requires a complete, holistic approach supported by the right people, the right tools and the right environment.Personalisation and the Power of UniquenessNo two guests arrive with the same life, health history or goals.At Alive, every retreat is carefully personalised. Our facilitators work closely with each guest to understand their health, lifestyle, emotional wellbeing and future vision before designing a program that supports their unique needs.Unlike many wellness resorts, our retreats are actively guided. Guests are supported by facilitators and wellness professionals who help structure their experience and ensure they receive the right therapies, practices and insights throughout their stay.This is why we keep our retreats boutique in size or offer one-to-one programs, allowing every guest to receive genuine attention and personalised care.The Most Holistic Wellness Retreat in the WorldAlive is built on a truly holistic approach that addresses the full human experience.Physically, we work with advanced health and wellbeing practices including biohacking, biomedical testing, nutrition, naturopathy, detoxification, movement and recovery therapies to restore the body and increase vitality.Mentally and emotionally, we use powerful tools and practices designed to release stress, reset patterns and help guests work with their mind in a more empowering way.At the level of life direction and purpose, guests are guided to reconnect with what matters most and take meaningful action toward the life they want to create.Every retreat works across body, mind, heart, soul and purpose, creating a level of integration rarely found in traditional wellness retreats.Luxury, Beauty and Service as Part of HealingWe believe that the environment in which healing takes place matters.When someone chooses to step away from their life to focus on their wellbeing, the experience should be beautiful, supportive and deeply restorative. This is why Alive retreats are held in luxury wellness resorts and stunning natural environments.Guests experience five-star hospitality, private accommodation, exceptional cuisine and attentive service, allowing them to fully relax and focus on themselves.Our retreats remain intentionally boutique in size so that the atmosphere stays calm, peaceful and personal rather than busy or commercial.Tools For Transformation, Not More TalkAlive is not built around endless discussion or analysing the past.Our philosophy focuses on practical tools and empowering practices that help guests create real change in their lives. Through coaching, workshops, wellness education and personalised guidance, guests learn how to manage stress, build healthier habits, strengthen emotional resilience and create a lifestyle that supports their wellbeing.The goal is not simply to feel better during the retreat, but to leave with the clarity, confidence and tools to continue creating change in the real world.Right Tools. Right Order. Right People.One of the most important principles at Alive is doing things properly.Our retreats are carefully structured so that each guest receives the right therapies, guidance and experiences in the right sequence. Our team of wellness professionals work closely together, ensuring every part of the retreat supports the same outcome.This philosophy can be summed up simply:Right tools. Right order. Right time. Right people.When these elements come together in the right environment, meaningful change can happen far more quickly than most people expect.

items.q: Where did Alive come from?
a: Alive was created by accident when the founder, Heidi, in her early twenties ( a few decades ago ) sought treatment from chronic anxiety, severe burn out and long term health issues that were crippling her career, life and relationships. Unable to function Heidi set out on a journey to heal herself after feeling that the medical model failed her many times. At a loss for information and answers Heidi turned to study and trialled and tested a range of modalities for the mental, physical, emotional and energetic transformation she was seeking only to find the journey long, slow and frustrating taking years to piece together all the information, education and life changing tools she wanted for health and total transformation of the self. During her time of study and exploring the worlds best treatment options for mental and emotional wellbeing Heidi curated a unique set of life saving and changing tools and treatment protocols that when delivered in the right order at the right time offer radical results to not only heal the issues for good but to create a life worth living with a focus on long term change.

Surrounded by the elite in Heidi’s business circles she began to realise she wasn’t the only one in need of such a process. Watching friends head to rehab or trying long winded disempowering therapy models and fail over and over on the search for meaning she officially launched Alive in 2009 focusing on an exclusive clientele with specific issues that no one else seem to understand. Alive became an immediately sought after program for those wanting to combine the best of both proven therapeutic approaches with natural and alternative methods using an intensive fast tracked system never seen before in the mental health industry. With two centres serving clients around the clock Alive expanded quickly as word spread of a program that was built on personal, professional skill from a world class team that Heidi gathered as her army against the mundane mental health system that was commonly available. Post covid Alive has returned to its roots with a small exclusive team working one to one with a select few individuals desiring the ultimate treatment program in absolute confidentiality in Bali.

items.q: Are the programs evidence based or holistic?
a: Both. We believe in both measures. Most importantly we believing in treating the whole person and we believe in healing the issues for good through empowerment.

Alive’s holistic treatment process focuses on treating not just the top layer of the presenting problems, but all underlying issues to help promote lasting success through recovery tools and long lasting life change that sees our clients becoming the best version of themselves.

items.q: What is a typical day at an Alive wellness retreat?
a: Every day at an Alive wellness retreat is designed to help you feel rested, energised and supported. While there is a daily schedule of wellness experiences, guests are always free to participate in as much or as little as they wish.Some guests prefer to fill their days with classes, therapies and nature experiences, while others simply enjoy the peaceful environment of the resort, the spa and the beautiful surroundings.A typical day at the retreat may look something like this:MorningMany guests begin their day with a sunrise yoga, meditation or fitness class, helping the body gently wake up and set a calm tone for the day.After class, guests enjoy a nourishing breakfast prepared by the retreat chefs, with options ranging from fresh tropical fruits and wholefoods to personalised detox or cleanse menus.Guests may then attend a health consultation, private wellness session or spa treatment, or simply relax by the pool or beach.MiddayLate morning and early afternoon often include alive coaching, movement sessions or healing experiences led by the Alive wellness team.Guests can also spend time enjoying the spa, sauna, recovery facilities or beachfront relaxation areas, or explore the surrounding nature and culture through guided excursions.Lunch is served at the resort restaurant and focuses on fresh, nourishing cuisine designed to support energy, digestion and overall wellbeing.AfternoonAfternoons are intentionally spacious and restorative. Guests may choose to enjoy spa treatments, private therapy session, relaxation time, beach walks or time in nature.Some days also include guided cultural or adventure experiences, such as visiting hidden beaches, waterfalls, temples or local villages.EveningEvenings often include gentle meditation, relaxation sessions or acupuncture designed to help the body unwind after the day.Dinner is served in the resort restaurant, where guests enjoy healthy gourmet cuisine in a relaxed and beautiful setting.Many guests finish the day with a sunset walk, quiet reflection or time relaxing in their private villa, allowing the body and mind to fully reset.A retreat designed around youWhile this gives an idea of the flow of the retreat, every guest’s experience is different.Some guests focus on spa, relaxation and daily wellness classes, while others personalise their stay with private coaching, health sessions or deeper transformational programs.The retreat schedule is designed to support your wellbeing, not overwhelm it, allowing you to move at your own pace while receiving the care and guidance you need.

It is also for those dealing with long term health issues and toxicity build up who require advanced biomedical treatment, biohacking and unique detox protocols customised to their needs. Usually combined with our holistic de stress and holistic health program our detox protocol and complete life reset offers a complete reset for health, energy, habits, physical fitness, mental and emotional detox and life reset.

Please not although Alive does work with clients who have light addictions, BUT we no longer offer intensive medical detox or rehab. You can complete your detox and then our program customised to your needs afterwards if you love the Alive program and would like to get to the root cause of your addictions.

items.q: Why Our Mental Health Program Is Different

When the root causes that are truly driving the issues are found (and they are rarely what you think they are) we can then create an intensive treatment plan first to provide immediate relief of physical, mental and emotional symptoms in a calm and supportive environment as well as eradicate what is driving the issues for the long term.Natural Treatment Where PossibleWe believe that every human system has the ability to find natural balance when specific physical treatment is in place that is unique to the individual, mental issues are dealt with, emotional tools are taught to overcome what holds us back and energetic balancing rectifies the unseen. When combining all of these approaches at once we see record results - not just immediately but for the long term. Life Transformation Is The End GoalWe focus equally on real life change to ensure that the results you experience during your program continue for life in the real world. Working Across All AreasA large percentage of our clients are dealing with multiple issues at once with their health/mental health/life/relationships/trauma and more. The Alive team is skilled at working with a range of dual diagnosis individuals to ensure that the whole person is considered in treatment and not just parts of the issue. Intensive Treatment - Uniqueness is KeyAlive also doesn’t believe, and has proven thousands of times, that healing does not need to take months or years. Through intensive fast tracked team work that targets of all the issues together we see recovery in record time. Many of our clients have spent years focusing on what is ‘wrong’ with them and reinforcing the issue with disempowering drip fed therapy frameworks and sometimes unnecessary medication that is masking the real issues to be dealt with. We have seen many times that the treatment they are receiving is in fact part of the problem. It is for this reason that we believe in working fast to align our clients with the greatest possible version of themselves on every level using a proven tool kit that works.EmpoweringClients usually treatment - which is why we created a nurturing space to be fully supported. It takes a huge amount of courage to undergo this style of program. Clients love our team and program because we are not spending weeks peeling the onion of your past or pulling apart what is wrong with you. We are instead focused on dealing with head on what is holding you back, healing the physical body so that mentally you become balanced and creating an integrated plan for life change that has you stepping fully into your power from day 1. We believe the healing happens in the doing of being the greatest version of yourself. Our team are compassionate, loving and highly skilled but also direct, raw and real when it comes to getting you the results you seek.
